panels.title: Плотность распределения скоров · state / merch

targets.rawSql:
WITH selected AS (SELECT least(19, floor(score * 20)::int) AS bin FROM scores
        WHERE $__timeFilter(scored_at) AND ('__all' IN (${state:sqlstring}) OR us_state IN (${state:sqlstring})) AND ('__all' IN (${merchant:sqlstring}) OR merch IN (${merchant:sqlstring}))),
        counts AS (SELECT bin, count(*) AS n FROM selected GROUP BY bin)
        SELECT to_char(b / 20.0, 'FM0.00') || '–' || to_char((b+1) / 20.0, 'FM0.00') AS score_bin,
        coalesce(n, 0)::float / greatest((SELECT count(*) FROM selected), 1) / 0.05 AS density
        FROM generate_series(0,19) b LEFT JOIN counts ON bin=b ORDER BY b

panels.description: 20 интервалов ширины 0.05. Высота=count/(N×0.05), площадь равна 1 при N>0. Последний интервал включает score=1. Фильтры применяются ко всему выбранному времени.

panels.title: TPS обработки · state / merch

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(scored_at,'5s',0), count(*) / 5.0 AS tps FROM scores WHERE $__timeFilter(scored_at) AND ('__all' IN (${state:sqlstring}) OR us_state IN (${state:sqlstring})) AND ('__all' IN (${merchant:sqlstring}) OR merch IN (${merchant:sqlstring})) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Время фактического скоринга, интервалы 5 секунд. SQL видит результаты после записи writer.

panels.title: Доля фрода по категории · последние 1000

targets.rawSql:
WITH last_1000 AS (SELECT * FROM scores ORDER BY scored_at DESC, transaction_id DESC LIMIT 1000)
        SELECT cat_id, avg(fraud_flag::int) AS fraud_ratio FROM last_1000 WHERE ('__all' IN (${state:sqlstring}) OR us_state IN (${state:sqlstring})) AND ('__all' IN (${merchant:sqlstring}) OR merch IN (${merchant:sqlstring}))
        GROUP BY cat_id ORDER BY fraud_ratio DESC

panels.description: Последние 1000 уникальных результатов глобально, затем фильтры state/merch. Диапазон времени не ограничивает это окно; пока строк меньше 1000, используется доступное количество.

panels.title: Топ продавцов по сумме подозрительных покупок

targets.rawSql: SELECT merch, sum(amount) FILTER (WHERE fraud_flag) AS flagged_amount FROM scores WHERE $__timeFilter(scored_at) AND ('__all' IN (${state:sqlstring}) OR us_state IN (${state:sqlstring})) AND ('__all' IN (${merchant:sqlstring}) OR merch IN (${merchant:sqlstring})) GROUP BY merch HAVING bool_or(fraud_flag) ORDER BY flagged_amount DESC LIMIT 10

panels.description: Дополнительный бизнес-график: помогает приоритизировать расследования по объёму подозрительных покупок. Это предсказания модели, не подтверждённые потери.

panels.title: Скоры и доля фрода по версии · выбранный сегмент

targets.rawSql: SELECT model_version, count(*) AS scores, avg(fraud_flag::int) AS fraud_ratio, sum(amount) FILTER (WHERE fraud_flag) AS flagged_amount FROM scores WHERE $__timeFilter(scored_at) AND ('__all' IN (${state:sqlstring}) OR us_state IN (${state:sqlstring})) AND ('__all' IN (${merchant:sqlstring}) OR merch IN (${merchant:sqlstring})) GROUP BY model_version ORDER BY model_version
